correctness.rationale: All nonzero diagonal and scalar assumptions and the two-sided shadowing quantifiers are explicit. Unit-modulus coefficients give a drift obstruction; bounded-modulus high-degree monomials give pulse pseudotrajectories whose would-be tracing Taylor coefficients violate Cauchy bounds. Contractive coordinates yield a finite hyperbolic Taylor block plus a geometrically contracted high-degree tail; Green corrections converge in every compact-open seminorm. Expanding case follows by inverse time. The 5,028 rational checks are illustrative and not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete iff classification for a natural family directly motivated by a 2026 existence theorem: it distinguishes monomial resonance, coordinatewise contraction/expansion and mixed-direction growth; it proves a mixed-direction obstruction even with every monomial off the unit circle. This provides a useful boundary and prevents misapplying finite-dimensional spectral hyperbolicity to nonnormable entire-function spaces.
